title: Live Sports Dashboards
summary: Zero-dependency static data dashboards hosted on GitHub Pages, delivering sub-second live visual telemetry for NFL scores and field positions, NBA shot charts, and cycling competitions.
details: Engineered with vanilla ES6 and CSS Grid without framework overhead. Showcases three live deployments: the NFL Live tactical radar and win probability engine, the NBA Live court shot chart and Scorigami tracker, and the Tour de France Points Classification radar. Audited with custom contrast and responsive geometry rules before deployment.

title: Sports Analysis
summary: Deep-dive empirical sports modelling and statistical audits separating tactical decision quality from real-world execution bias across the NFL and UFC.
details: Features 'Fourth Down Lab' (an Eyeshield 21-inspired NFL coaching audit evaluating 1,718 fourth-down decisions using Python nfl4th/nflfastR multinomial XGBoost win-probability models) and an empirical scorecard audit of 31,881 UFC rounds analysing judge dissent rates and scoring anomalies.

title: RhythmQuest
summary: A local-first, sensory-accessible daily habit and action tracker designed for neurodiverse minds, combining a single-task focus view with optional low-pressure game elements.
details: Built with React 19, TypeScript, and offline-first Service Worker caching with zero cloud tracking. Features an on-device step helper, deadline-based focus timer with session recovery, streak shields, four three-stage illustrated companions, nine interface languages, and customisable reading comfort controls including Lexend typography.

title: Windows 11 Media & Audio Pipeline Tools
summary: Personal Python GUI wrappers and PowerShell automation scripts built exclusively for my local Windows 11 PC to handle batch media archiving and spatial audio inspection.
details: Built as bespoke local utilities to bypass bloated third-party media managers on my own workstation. Wraps yt-dlp, gallery-dl, and FFmpeg into clean desktop workflows for batch downloading, metadata organisation, and verifying Dolby Atmos eARC passthrough on local .mkv and .mp4 containers. Hardcoded to my personal hardware and file paths, so not packaged for public release.
